limitations: Not a construction for every prime power.
No classification of all possible symplectic point-line matchings or non-complete-intersection space fillers.
Only the first two zeta coefficients are determined.
The finite programs do not test geometric smoothness.
Full historical-priority review is not claimed.
scientific_integrity: The theorem is conditional on geometric smoothness and geometric integrality. All prime powers are proved through binary line restrictions and symplectic linear algebra; finite checks illustrate two published examples, not general validity. Historical priority and the source examples' smoothness are not independently certified.
title: Rational tangent matching and quadratic-point exclusion for minimal space-filling complete intersections
